SURVIVING 71 poster revealed
2018-12-23T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/surviving-71-poster-revealed-1677367

Wahid Ibn Reza, who made Bangladesh proud through his involvement in visual effects work in many Hollywood blockbusters, has revealed the poster of his upcoming animated short film Survivor 71 . He is the writer, director and executive producer of the film. The short is said to based on the Liberation War, as it is something that Wahid says is “tough and challenging.” Slated for release in 2020, the teaser-trailer will be out early next year.
